RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning your sex was not a distinguishing factor in the selection decision. Raising the panel's gender composition would undermine your credibility, as an all-male panel selecting one man over another does not indicate sex discrimination against you. 

While an all-male panel may reflect poor diversity practices or fail to meet internal civil service guidelines for interview composition, it does not demonstrate bias between two male applicants. The appointee's international project experience was likely the deciding merit factor. Focus instead on politely following up on your request for written feedback to learn how to strengthen future applications.
